name: The gateway pavilion at the A-Ma temple, Macau, its guardian lions, and a cat
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: Drawings of the gateway pavilion of the A-Ma (or Ma-Kok) temple in Macau, with detailed sudies of the stone lions (one male, one female) which flank the steps; also a drawing of a cat. On the back is a drawing of Tanka boats beached and adapted as dwellings, with sketches of figures and a dog.
